verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an on-device iOS git client that clones repositories locally, can link external Files directories, and syncs to remotes of your choice, including private GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea instances or a self-hosted git server. That indirectly lets users control where their repository data lives. However, its AI commit-message suggestions send staged diffs to OpenAI, with no documented region or residency control. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection or documentation, residency controls for AI-processed data (OpenAI), a documented statement of where any vendor-side data is stored.
